title: Boundless
subtitle: Thirty carats, uninterrupted — the Liquid Carat™ idea at its fullest.

stone.origin: Natural. Available in round brilliant diamonds or vivid blue sapphires. No-clasp continuous flex setting.

description: Bez Ambar's fullest expression of the Liquid Carat™ idea — roughly thirty carats of round brilliants set in a continuous, no-clasp line that pours around the wrist and moves with it. There is no hinge, no closure, nothing to interrupt the circle; the bracelet drapes and shifts as the hand does, a single unbroken run of light. Shown in white diamond and in vivid blue sapphire, each made to order in the metal chosen at commission.
